issues.title: STUDYID is read from SDTM AE, not the ADSL source the documents name
issues.summary: Define-XML and the data guide name ADSL as the STUDYID source; the specification and the original adae.sas program both take STUDYID from the SDTM AE records.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADAE.STUDYID: 'ADSL.STUDYID'. Data guide page 4: the core variables, including STUDYID, were merged from ADSL into all analysis datasets.
issues.observed: The specification derives STUDYID as AE.STUDYID. adae.sas keeps no STUDYID from ADSL (lines 19-20) and takes it from the SDTM AE records it reads.
issues.action: Decide the source of record: read STUDYID from ADSL in the specification, or document that ADAE takes STUDYID from SDTM AE, as adae.sas does.

issues.title: USUBJID is read from SDTM AE, not the ADSL source the documents name
issues.summary: Define-XML and the data guide name ADSL as the USUBJID source; the specification reads USUBJID from the SDTM AE records.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADAE.USUBJID: 'ADSL.USUBJID'. Data guide page 4 lists USUBJID among the core variables merged from ADSL into all analysis datasets.
issues.observed: The specification derives USUBJID as AE.USUBJID. USUBJID is the matching key, so equal values do not show that the documented ADSL source is read.
issues.action: Read USUBJID from ADSL in the specification, or document that ADAE takes USUBJID from SDTM AE and uses ADSL only as the subject lookup.

issues.title: Completely missing AE start dates are not imputed with the first-dose date
issues.summary: The SAP imputes a completely missing AE start date as the day of first dose; neither the specification nor adae.sas implements that branch.
issues.expected: SAP page 16: 'In the case of a completely missing adverse event start date, the start date will be imputed as the day of first dose.'
issues.observed: The specification returns a missing ASTDT when AESTDTC is empty. adae.sas lines 28-31 impute only year-month dates. Define-XML says no event has a completely missing start date.
issues.action: Add the first-dose fallback to ASTDT, or record that the SAP branch is not implemented because no event in this study has a completely missing start date.

issues.title: Year-month start dates before first dose are imputed despite the SAP prohibition
issues.summary: The SAP forbids imputing a partial start date that clearly falls before treatment; adae.sas imputes day 01 for every year-month start date.
issues.expected: SAP page 16: 'No imputation of adverse events dates where the partial date clearly indicates a start prior to the beginning of treatment will be done.'
issues.observed: adae.sas lines 28-31 impute day 01 for every year-month AESTDTC; the condition limiting this to the treatment-start year is commented out. Only year-only dates stay unimputed, as Define-XML states.
issues.action: Decide whether year-month dates before first dose are imputed: restrict the imputation if the SAP governs, or state the Define-XML rule as the governing one in the SAP.

issues.title: AE duration is withheld after start-date imputation without a documented rule
issues.summary: The specification and adae.sas give no duration when the start day was imputed; Define-XML states AENDT-ASTDT+1 without that condition, and no retained document states it.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADAE.ADURN: 'ADURN=AENDT-ASTDT+1', using the final analysis start date, including an imputed one.
issues.observed: As written, the Define formula differs from the reference on 4 of 1191 records, where the reference has no duration. adae.sas lines 13-15 compute it before lines 28-31 impute the day; that reading matches.
issues.action: Document that duration is not derived when the start date is imputed (ASTDTF set), as adae.sas and the specification do, or derive it from the imputed ASTDT as Define-XML states.

issues.title: Treatment-emergent flag omits the SAP worsening and recurrence criteria
issues.summary: The SAP also counts pre-dose events that worsen, or resolve and recur, after first dose as treatment emergent; Define-XML, the specification and adae.sas use the start date alone.
issues.expected: SAP page 16 adds events that start before first dose and worsen after it, and events that resolve before it and recur after it; pages 32-33: 'start or worsen or recur on or after the start of treatment'.
issues.observed: Define-XML, the specification and adae.sas lines 40-41 set TRTEMFL='Y' only when ASTDT >= TRTSDT. No step identifies worsening or recurrence.
issues.action: Decide which definition governs ADAE. If the SAP governs, state how worsening and recurrence are identified; otherwise align the SAP text and table notes with the start-date rule.

issues.title: Partial start dates in the first-dose month are not counted as treatment emergent
issues.summary: The SAP counts a partial start date in the treatment-start year and month as treatment emergent; the specification and adae.sas impute day 01 and compare it with first dose.
issues.expected: SAP page 16: 'Adverse events will be considered treatment emergent if the year and/or the month is the same as the treatment start year and month.'
issues.observed: ASTDT sets a missing day to 01 and TRTEMFL compares complete dates, as adae.sas lines 28-31 and 40 do. An event imputed to the 1st of the first-dose month, before the dose day, is N.
issues.action: Add the same-month rule for partial start dates to TRTEMFL, or document that the day-01 imputed date compared with TRTSDT governs.

issues.title: Define-XML misspells the skin SOC name in the dermatologic query
issues.summary: Define-XML writes 'SKIN AND SUBC UTANEOUS TISSUE DISORDERS' with an embedded space; adae.sas tests the correct spelling. Run as written, the query differs on 181 of 1191 records.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM selects skin events by AEBODSYS and named substrings; data guide page 5 and SAP page 16 describe the dermatologic events of interest.
issues.observed: With the Define-XML spelling, 181 of 1191 records the reference marks DERMATOLOGIC EVENTS are blank. adae.sas lines 42-47 spell SUBCUTANEOUS; that reading reproduces the reference.
issues.action: Correct the SOC name in Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM to 'SKIN AND SUBCUTANEOUS TISSUE DISORDERS'.

issues.title: Dermatologic query is a fixed preferred-term list, not the documented query
issues.summary: Define-XML defines CQ01NAM by substring, SOC and exclusion tests; the specification enumerates fixed preferred terms that no retained document lists.
issues.expected: Define-XML: AEDECOD contains 'APPLICATION', 'DERMATITIS', 'ERYTHEMA' or 'BLISTER', or AEBODSYS is the skin SOC and AEDECOD is not COLD SWEAT, HYPERHIDROSIS or ALOPECIA.
issues.observed: The specification sets CQ01NAM when AE.AEDECOD is in a fixed list of preferred terms, with no substring or SOC test. The SAP promises a final term list, but no retained document enumerates it.
issues.action: Express the Define-XML query in the specification, or document the fixed list as the approved medical-review term list.

issues.title: Define-XML selects the wrong event group
issues.summary: The blank-query condition selects events outside the dermatologic group, conflicting with the guide and the reference flags. The implementation already selects dermatologic events.
issues.expected: Select CQ01NAM='DERMATOLOGIC EVENTS' and TRTEMFL='Y', then flag the first event by ASTDT and AESEQ within each subject.
issues.observed: Define-XML says CQ01NAM='', which excludes the populated dermatologic query. Applying that condition flags different records from the reference.
issues.action: Correct the AOCC01FL condition in Define-XML to CQ01NAM='DERMATOLOGIC EVENTS'. Keep TRTEMFL='Y' and the documented ASTDT, AESEQ order. The guide interpretation reproduces all reference flags.

issues.title: Sequence-only ordering omits the documented start-date priority
issues.summary: The documented rule orders eligible dermatologic events by ASTDT, then AESEQ. DERM_RN uses AESEQ alone. The chronological interpretation matches both the reference and yamaa flags on this dataset.
issues.expected: Within each subject, select the earliest treatment-emergent dermatologic event by ASTDT; use AESEQ to break ties.
issues.observed: DERM_RN orders by AESEQ alone. No difference from the chronological interpretation was observed in the tested flags.
issues.action: Add ASTDT before AESEQ in DERM_RN. Keep the dermatologic-event filter. This states the documented chronology; the tested data does not demonstrate an ordering failure.

issues.title: First-event flag orders by sequence number, not start date
issues.summary: Define-XML flags the first treatment-emergent event per subject by ASTDT, then AESEQ; TE_RN orders by AESEQ alone.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADAE.AOCCFL: subset to treatment-emergent events, sort by USUBJID, ASTDT and AESEQ, and flag the first record within each subject.
issues.observed: TE_RN orders treatment-emergent events within subject by AESEQ only, with no ASTDT priority.
issues.action: Add ASTDT before AESEQ in the TE_RN order.

issues.title: First-per-SOC flag groups by AESOC and orders by sequence number
issues.summary: Define-XML flags the first treatment-emergent event per subject and SOC (AEBODSYS) by ASTDT, then AESEQ; TE_SOC_RN groups differently and orders by AESEQ alone.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADAE.AOCCSFL: subset to treatment-emergent events, sort by USUBJID, AEBODSYS, ASTDT and AESEQ, and flag the first record within each subject and SOC.
issues.observed: TE_SOC_RN groups treatment-emergent events by STUDYID, USUBJID, AESOC, not AEBODSYS, and orders them by AESEQ only.
issues.action: Group TE_SOC_RN by AEBODSYS and add ASTDT before AESEQ, or document AESOC as the SOC grouping variable.

issues.title: First-per-term flag omits SOC grouping and start-date order
issues.summary: Define-XML flags the first treatment-emergent event per subject, SOC (AEBODSYS) and preferred term (AEDECOD) by ASTDT, then AESEQ; TE_PT_RN groups differently and orders by AESEQ alone.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADAE.AOCCPFL: subset to treatment-emergent events, sort by USUBJID, AEBODSYS, AEDECOD, ASTDT and AESEQ, and flag the first record within each subject, SOC and PT.
issues.observed: TE_PT_RN groups treatment-emergent events by STUDYID, USUBJID, AEDECOD, without AEBODSYS, and orders them by AESEQ only.
issues.action: Add AEBODSYS to the TE_PT_RN grouping and ASTDT before AESEQ in its order.

issues.expected: Define-XML ADAE.AOCC04FL: subset to serious treatment-emergent events, sort by USUBJID, AEBODSYS, AEDECOD, ASTDT and AESEQ, and flag the first record within each subject, SOC and PT.

issues.title: Partial AE end dates are completed despite the SAP no-imputation policy
issues.summary: The SAP says missing safety data will not be imputed; the specification completes a missing AE end-date month and day with 1.
issues.expected: SAP page 10: 'Missing baseline values and missing safety data will not be imputed.' The SAP's AE imputation exceptions concern start dates only.
issues.observed: AENDT imputes AEENDTC with month 1 and day 1 when they are missing. Define-XML ADAE.AENDT states only a conversion of AE.AEENDTC to a date.
issues.action: Remove the end-date completion so a partial AEENDTC stays missing, or document an end-date imputation exception to the SAP policy.

issues.title: AE end relative day is copied from SDTM instead of computed from analysis dates
issues.summary: Define-XML computes AENDY from AENDT and TRTSDT; the specification copies the SDTM AE.AEENDY.
issues.expected: Define-XML: if AENDT>=TRTSDT then AENDY=AENDT-TRTSDT+1; else if TRTSDT>AENDT then AENDY=AENDT-TRTSDT.
issues.observed: The specification sets AENDY to AE.AEENDY, the SDTM end relative day, without recomputing it from AENDT and TRTSDT.
issues.action: Compute AENDY from AENDT and TRTSDT as Define-XML states, or document AENDY as a copy of SDTM AEENDY.
